source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue building useful LeanFrontier machinery toward eventual work on Markov uniqueness. This submission is stacked on the separately validated Markov quadratic-residue theorem. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected three direct arithmetic consequences that strengthen the public API without reproving prerequisites: Mathlib's sum-of-two-squares characterization turns the square root of -1 modulo the Markov label into an explicit sum-of-two-squares representation; the prime-factor restriction sharpens to p = 2 or p ≡ 1 mod 4; and divisibility by 4 is excluded because a square root of -1 would then descend to ZMod 4, where it does not exist. These are classical consequences and do not prove the Frobenius/Markov uniqueness conjecture. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the targets and authored all Lean statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
